reason: My money already goes into index funds every month on autopilot and I barely look at it, so an AI pet that invests and rebalances for me solves a problem I don't have. And a demo-money app with an unpriced paid plan isn't worth signing up for on my commute.
objection: Why would I pay a monthly fee for an agent to manage what a free recurring index buy already does, and hand spending and trading power to an app that isn't even a real broker yet?
would_change_my_mind: A real-money account at a licensed broker that clearly costs less than what I pay now in total, and shows it beats my plain monthly index buy after fees.
